description: LeanCTX is the Context Gateway for AI Systems. Select task-relevant context, apply supported controls, connect local knowledge and inspect recorded evidence. Open-source Engine: CLI, MCP, hooks and supported proxy paths.

findings.title: Embedded MCP Server Detected
findings.description: Embedded MCP server detected in rust source, but tool enumeration was not possible. Manual review is required for auth, scope, and input validation.
findings.recommendation: Source-level MCP SDK usage was detected, but tools could not be enumerated statically. Run a sandboxed live scan if possible and manually review auth, scope, and input validation before trusting this server.
